items.title: Lillie Delk Christian Interview, 1961-04-25
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] What was Bricktop, Charlene? Charlene O'Germore? Well, uh, well...

ctx.x: No, no. She sang a little bit abroad, but not very much. But she sang show tunes and did so much theatrical work. I don't remember specifically that she ever sang blues or didn't. You know, she may have treated it as, I'll sing anything that comes along. Was Bricktop a singer?
What was Bricktop, Charlene? Charlene O'Germore? Well, uh, well...

That's the first time I've seen Bricktop in my life. No, she didn't know Bricktop. Well, I tell you, Bricktop was, uh... I mean, she was a comedian... A kind of comedian. Comedian. Comedian, and, you know, sang, too, you know. So she's, um... Her best stock, though, is personality. Personality, yeah. Personality, yeah. She's a very fine person. I heard you mention some of the other people there while I was on the show.
